name: ATC_CUST_PROF_SPEC_CHARS
description: store details of customer profile specifications chars

columns.name: CUST_PROF_SPEC_CHAR_ID
columns.description: Unique rowid

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: indicates if the character is active or not

columns.name: CUST_PROF_SPEC_CHAR_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of the spec char

columns.name: CHAR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates characteristic type code

columns.name: CHAR_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: A fully qualified name of the attribute that represents the characteristic.

columns.name: CUST_PROF_SPEC_CHAR_DESC
columns.description: Indicates the description of the spec char

columns.name: DISPLAY_TEXT
columns.description: A string. A word, term, or phrase by which can be displyed for user experience.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME
columns.description: The name refers to the source system from which the characteristics belongs to.

columns.name: CONFIGURABLE_FLAG
columns.description: if TRUE, the Boolean indiactes that customer profile spec characteristic is configurable.

columns.name: EXTENSIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies that values of the characteristics can be extended by adding new values when instantiating the characteristics

columns.name: ALLOWED_UNITS
columns.description: Indicates the allowed units for specified custom profile specification characteristics

columns.name: UNIQUE_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that indicates of a value is unique for the specification. Possible values are , "unique while value is in effect" and "unique whether the value is in effect or not"

columns.name: MIN_CARDINALITY
columns.description: The minimum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on

columns.name: MAX_CARDINALITY
columns.description: The maximum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on

columns.name: REGEX
columns.description: A rule or principle represented in regular expression used to derive the value of a characteristic value

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: A kind of value that the characteristic can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

columns.name: BALANCE_ELEM_CODE
columns.description: indicates the currency or non currency balance element code

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the actual class type of an entity

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the base class of a given resource that has been extended

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Start time from which the characteristic is valid

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: End Time to which the characteristic is valid

columns.name: AT_VALUE_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: indicates value schema location

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the entity

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Id of the entity to which it is associated

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
